# Bundled runtime dependency

`lzo1x/dist/index.cjs` and `lzo1x/LICENSE` are unmodified files from **lzo1x 1.0.1**, MIT licensed, copyright 2026 Mannes Brak.

- Source: https://github.com/mbtech-nl/lzo1x
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lzo1x/-/lzo1x-1.0.1.tgz
- npm integrity: `sha512-Zlk+Fn2L47oOVFudFxy/hguB1y3Ai3exmwyBu01kTTwbkd+Jmx8BoBS0yQfob47tKekWUofy3iRJx5HBxeTkdA==`

Bundled to allow offline execution with Node.js alone: no npm install, Python, native addon, or compiler. The caller bounds decoded sizes and emits blocks no larger than 128 KiB. Source maps are not required at runtime.
